_help: Songs for the lyre. Hold Lyre, then play the notes with Up / Down / Left / Right (Jump plays the middle string). A song only works once Orpheus knows it (ability 'song:<id>'). Traversal songs are free; combat songs cost Muse. 'range' is how far (px) the song reaches. Notes don't have to be on the beat, but a combat song played entirely on the beat costs half.
